title: Published multi-layer LARE closure authority extraction
scientific_question: What exact multi-layer integrated-Richards equations, constitutive averaging rules, interface-flux closure, boundary-condition formulas and time-integration semantics define the published LARE method that will be tested against SWAP Reference Richards?

authority_order.source: He et al. 2026, A Numerical Model for Integrated Form of Richards Equation, Hydrological Processes 40(1), DOI 10.1002/hyp.70396
Junhao He 2021 Auburn dissertation, Modeling Soil Moisture Dynamics in Wetlands
authority_order.role: historical multi-layer LARE derivation and algorithm authority where the 2026 web article does not expose equations

authority_order.source: He et al. 2021, A two-layer numerical model of soil moisture dynamics: Model development, DOI 10.1016/j.jhydrol.2021.126797
He et al. 2022, Two-Layer numerical model of soil moisture dynamics: Model assessment and Bayesian uncertainty estimation, DOI 10.1016/j.jhydrol.2022.128327
authority_order.role: documented applicability limits and layer-thickness sensitivity
algorithm/source corroboration only; no source-code inheritance into SWAP5

required_extraction: vertical coordinate and flux sign convention
layer storage / average moisture state definition
integrated continuity equation for every interior layer
definition of layer-average unsaturated hydraulic conductivity
interlayer hydraulic conductivity / interface flux formula
treatment of discontinuous soil hydraulic parameters at a material interface
time integrator and iterative corrector semantics
state bounds and wet/saturated transition treatment
published numerical stabilization or clipping rules, if any

transcription_policy.equations: transcribe symbolically with source equation/page identifiers where source access permits
transcription_policy.unit_check: derive dimensions for every term independently
transcription_policy.sign_check: rederive the layer water balance from continuity before accepting source notation
limiting_checks: two-layer limit reproduces He et al. 2021
identical adjacent layers do not create a spurious interface discontinuity
transcription_policy.no_invention: If a required multi-layer closure term cannot be recovered unambiguously from published or author-supplied authority, CA1 closes BLOCKED_SOURCE_AUTHORITY rather than filling the gap with a plausible formula.

clean_sheet_rule: Published equations and algorithm semantics may be reimplemented clean-sheet. No LARE source file is copied into production or research code.
